section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1984
title: Accidental Deaths in India
notes: Volume of Accidental Deaths per Lakh of Population in the States, Union Territories and Metropolitan Cities

The All-India volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population went up to 18.3 in 1984 in comparison to 16.7 in 1979 but it has gone down in comparison to the years 1974, 1975, 1977 and 1978 when it was 18.8, 18.8, 18.8 and 18.6 respectively. For the Union Territories as a whole, it was 43.58 in 1984 against 45.01 in 1983, which was more than the all-India average as well as the volume of all the States taken together. The volume of accidental deaths for all the 12 Metropolitan cities taken together (48.27) was also more than the All-India average, states average and the U.Ts average of (18.30), (17.91) and (43.58) respectively.
